ii) Construct phasor diagram.

questions.question:
a) A $440\text{ V}$, $50\text{ Hz}$, 3-phase supply has delta-connected load having $(31 + j59)\ \Omega$ between R and Y, $(30 - j40)\ \Omega$ between Y and B and $(80 + j60)\ \Omega$ between B and R. Find the line currents, phase currents and the power supplied for the sequence RYB. [6]
